docs.index_intro: Browse the Delatometry ROS 2 stack documentation. Choose a topic from the list or the sidebar.
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.live_hint: Live refresh ~1 Hz (WebSocket). Service buttons still use normal form POST.
dashboard.service_sudo_hint: Requires passwordless sudo for systemctl — run sudo bash src/webui/scripts/install_sudoers.sh on the Pi.
programs.title: Programs
program_view.measurements_hint: Each run is stored separately (e.g. program 4 → 4.1, 4.2, 4.3). Use Export to download one run (measurements, program info, charts).
program_view.no_runs: No experiment runs yet. Start the program to create run 1.
program_run.title: Experiment {label}
program_run.charts_after_stop: Charts are generated when the run stops.
program_run.charts_missing: No chart image yet. Stop the run or wait for chart generation.
program_run.no_freq_data: No frequency data in this run.
program_run.scroll_more: Scroll down to load more rows (100 per batch).
program_run.delete_confirm: Delete experiment {label} and all its measurements?
program_new.title: New program
program_new.desc_hint: Name or describe this temperature program. Other sections unlock after this is filled in.
program_new.steps_chain: Steps must chain without gaps: each step's start must equal the previous step's stop.
program_new.steps_example: Example: step 1 → 40–100 K, step 2 must start at 100 K (not 200 K).
program_new.step_list_hint: Edit cells, then click outside a row to save
program_new.no_steps: No steps yet — add one in the block below.
program_new.add_step_locked: Enter a description above to enable adding steps.
program_new.add_step_invalid: Enter valid numbers for all step fields.
program_new.add_step_fail: Could not add step — check connection and try again.
program_new.create_hint: Complete description, valid temperature steps, and E7-20 settings.
program_new.create_ready: All checks passed — you can create the program.
program_edit.title: Edit program {id}
program_edit.desc_hint: Update the program name or notes. Temperature steps save automatically when you edit a row.
program_edit.save_hint: Saves description, E7-20 settings, and any step edits in the table above.
experiment.title: Experiment
experiment.manual_pwm_hint: Check Enable control, set target (K), then Apply. Requires Configuration → Core: PWM control enabled and core service restarted. Drives PWM on CH1 and CH2.
config.title: Configuration
config.env_hint: Settings in {path}. Enable Restart service to apply immediately.
config.vpn_hint: Choose a VPN provider for remote access. When "Connect on boot" is enabled, the connection starts automatically after the network is up.
config.vpn_openvpn_hint: Upload a client .ovpn profile from your VPN server. Optional username/password are stored in /etc/delatometry/openvpn/auth.txt.
config.vpn_zt_hint: Create a network at my.zerotier.com and authorize this device after joining.
validation.description_too_long: Description must be at most 500 characters.
validation.no_steps: Add at least one temperature step.
validation.minutes_non_positive: Step {step_id}: duration must be greater than 0 minutes.
validation.t_start_below_min: Step {step_id}: start temperature must be at least {t_min} K.
validation.t_stop_above_max: Step {step_id}: stop temperature must be at most {t_max} K.
validation.t_start_not_below_stop: Step {step_id}: stop temperature must be greater than start temperature.
validation.overlap_with_previous: Step {step_id}: start temperature overlaps step {prev_step} — set start to match the previous stop.
validation.gap_after_previous: Step {step_id}: start temperature must equal the previous step's stop ({expected} K), not {value} K.
validation.e720_no_frequencies: Select at least one E7-20 frequency.
validation.e720_range_max: Range max Hz must be greater than 0.
validation.e720_range_max_below_enabled: Range max must be at least the highest enabled frequency in Range mode.
